final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id COLLATE BINARY = a.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY p.throws), shares AS (SELECT throws, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), scored AS (SELECT throws, record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(record_count), AVG(share), AVG(share - average_share) FROM scored WHERE share > average_share
